title: [nightly/speed] Look up a course's hole by its place in the list first
summary: Course.get_hole, called about 100,000 times per analytics request, checks hole n at index n−1 before walking the list. Every figure that needs a hole's par or stroke index gets faster; any other course shape falls back to the old walk.
